`~ ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) = + _ [ ] { } \ | ; : . ' " , < > / ?`

Windows virtual machines can't include periods or end with hyphens.

Linux virtual machines can't end with periods or hyphens.

section_notes: Azure virtual machines have two distinct names: resource name and host name. When you create a virtual machine in the portal, the same value is used for both names. The restrictions in the preceding table are for the host name. The actual resource name can have up to 64 characters.
